title: Strata profile-driven batch advisor and controlled rollback playbook
creator: Aisha Khan
description: We need a recommendation engine (advisor) that consumes continuous workload profiles and emits batching + caching parameter suggestions per workload cohort, plus a bounded safe-apply and rollback playbook. Current autotune experiments are manual and risk transient latency spikes when applied across fleets. Strata advisor should: 1) create deterministic workload fingerprints; 2) score candidate batch/caching configs with safety heuristics; 3) stage shadow applies and gradual commits; 4) provide automated rollback triggers and operator runbooks.
acceptance_criteria: Advisor produces per-cohort suggestions (batch_size, max_in_flight, kv_cache_ttl, prefix_cache_enable) for >=90% of observed production cohorts
A/B rollout via shadow apply + 5% canary + 25% ramp available as a single click in Console
Automated rollback triggers on 1.5x error rate, >20% tail latency regression, or 10% throughput drop
End-to-end tests in staging validate advisor suggestions with synthetic replay harness
proposed_solution: Profile pipeline: collect request traces, token length histograms, kv-hit ratios, sequence length percentiles, and per-route cold-start counts into a daily strata snapshot
Workload stratification: fingerprint requests by route+model+input_shape+client_tier and cluster into 'strata' using lightweight hashing plus time decay
Scoring heuristics: combine cost delta estimator, inferred tail-latency delta, and kv-sensitivity to compute a safety score (low/medium/high) and a recommended parameter set
Continuous tuner: maintain rolling window of telemetry, validate suggested config in shadow mode (no traffic impact), then propose canary with automatic gating checks
Safe-apply orchestration: a three-phase rollout (shadow -> canary -> ramp) with automated metrics gates and immediate rollback actions
implementation_plan: Week 1: Implement strata snapshot schema and exporter (agent + ingestion), add lightweight fingerprinting function (Aisha)
Week 2: Build offline scoring prototype using historical traces and cost model (Ben + Mariela), produce dashboard of candidate suggestions
Week 3: Implement shadow-apply path in runtime (feature-flagged), wire metric collection for gated checks (SLOs, error-rate, kv-hit) (Ben)
Week 4: Add canary/ramp orchestration in control-plane, small Console UI for proposals and one-click apply/rollback (Product)
Week 5: Run staged rollout on internal test tenants, collect regression signal, tune heuristics and thresholds
Deliverables: strata exporter PR, scoring service proto, control-plane rollout API, Console proposal UX sketch, runbook doc
monitoring_alerts: Alert: automated-rollout-rollback if error_rate > 1.5x baseline for 10m
Alert: throughput_drop > 10% sustained for 5m after canary ramp step
Dashboard: batch-advisor-proposals with status (shadow/canary/ramped/rolledback) and recent metric deltas
rollback_playbook: Automatic: rollback to previous traffic routing if any automated gate trips during canary or ramp
Manual: operator page shows diffs, link to last working config, and a 'revert' button that replays previous config to control-plane
Post-mortem: tag rollout attempts with correlation id, capture sample requests and outputs for 15m before/after, and trigger a lightweight eval to detect quality regressions
Safety net: maintain 'no-touch' list of high-risk routes (customer_impact=high) that require manual approval to change
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: false-positive rollbacks due to noisy telemetry - Mitigation: use multiple aligned signals and require 2/3 gates to trip for automatic rollback
Risk: config suggestions cause downstream model divergence for stateful routes - Mitigation: block heuristics for routes marked stateful and force manual review
Risk: KV cache TTL changes introduce cold-start bursts - Mitigation: ramp-up TTL decrease slowly and prioritize prefix cache warmup in shadow mode
Risk: cost model inaccuracies - Mitigation: calibrate using 7-day historical billing + synthetic microbenchmarks per model family
tasks: Define strata snapshot schema and retention policy
Add fingerprinting to runtime ingress path (sampling 1%)
Implement scoring service with cost/latency estimators
Add shadow-apply plumbing to runtime and mark feature-flagged
Create Console UX for proposals + one-click apply/rollback
Author runbook for on-call and SRE
open_questions: What is the appropriate sampling fraction for fingerprinting to balance cost vs signal?
Should we treat model-agnostic routes differently than model-bound ones for scoring?
What SLO deltas should be tolerated for low-customer-impact routes? (product input needed)
